protocol.protocol: Duffing bounded search after the original ten-input negative result
protocol.authorization: The user authorized subsequent computation and quality refinements on 2026-09-24.
protocol.optimizer: SLSQP maxiter=5000, ftol=1e-12, unchanged objective, regularizer and bounds. Each start at most 900 seconds. Iteration history includes the 1200-iteration value without extra objective evaluations.
protocol.dimensions: Training N96 and d48; reference 64/80 and circuit padding 96/112; r10 and T1 with beta0.1.
protocol.selection: Minimum training objective within each arm before evaluating either arm. All original ten inputs are development for this refinement.
protocol.stopping_rule: Complete these four starts and two selected-pair evaluations, then stop. The twelve fresh inputs are used once and do not trigger another training adjustment.
protocol.interpretation: The original-seed arm isolates a larger iteration allowance. The second arm is a broader-fit feasibility check and cannot isolate the separate effects of coverage, depth and initialization. Failure under the budget is not a capacity proof.
protocol.boundary_assessment: Apply the unchanged 1e-6 threshold to max(N96,N112) boundary populations. Archive both and the original N96 field. This is a stricter new assessment than the archived N96-only verdict, and any resulting verdict change is not attributed to training iterations.

comparisons.evidence_scope: finite-family numerical validation with empirical reference and padding differences
finite-family numerical validation with empirical reference and padding differences

evidence_scope: The iteration arm changes only maxiter relative to its archived seed. The coverage arm jointly changes training phases, depth, initialization and iteration allowance. The fresh twelve-state coherent family is evaluated only after both selections, with no further tuning.
